prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic social-media mirror selfie in a soft-grunge bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair, fair skin, winged eyeliner, soft makeup, and a neutral expression, wearing an opaque black ribbed top, knee-length black pleated skirt with gothic grommet belt, white ankle socks, and casual shoes.
prompt.composition_elements: Mirror selfie from a comfortable seated position on a bed, body angled slightly to the side, grey bedding, plain white walls, small window, Hello Kitty-inspired optional phone case, and visible silver cross necklace and delicate bracelet.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused indoor light, gentle bedroom shadows, soft-grunge E-girl and Y2K palette with kawaii accents, candid social-media mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-resolution smartphone mirror photography, sharp focus, natural skin and fabric texture, realistic phone grain and dynamic range.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An approved adult woman with long wavy brown hair, fair skin, winged eyeliner, soft makeup, and a neutral expression takes a mirror selfie while seated comfortably on a bed. She wears an opaque black ribbed top, a knee-length black pleated skirt with a gothic grommet belt and hanging straps, white ankle socks, and casual shoes. She holds a smartphone with an optional cute character case and wears a delicate gold bracelet and silver cross necklace. The bedroom has grey duvet bedding, plain white walls, and a small background window. Soft diffused indoor lighting, soft-grunge E-girl and Y2K fashion, kawaii accents, photorealistic high-resolution smartphone texture, and sharp focus.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, crop top, mini skirt, exposed midriff, lingerie, sheer clothing, kneeling sexual pose, arched back, sexualized framing, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

assets.usage: Approved-adult identity, hair, gothic outfit palette, necklace, phone case, bedroom, bedding, and selfie composition reference.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required approved-adult reference. Preserve identity, hair, gothic palette, bedroom, bedding, accessories, and mirror framing; replaceable elements are the phone-case character and small decor. Keep the outfit opaque and pose comfortable. Any graphic typography is optional and must remain subordinate to the wardrobe.

changes: Clarified approved adult; changed crop top and mini skirt to opaque coverage and changed kneeling-on-bed framing to a comfortable seated mirror selfie.
